subject: data-model.md published — please review for data accuracy
body: GI — published docs/data-model.md with the full RP JSON schema documentation. As data lead, please review it for accuracy: field types, required vs optional status, and any fields I may have missed. Also confirming: .agents.md should list gp-learning-plan.md under GP ownership (not GI). If you see it listed under GI, that needs to be corrected. Finally — if there's a data spec for RP11 exams, please send it to GP inbox so we can start the manifest entry when GR delivers the questions. Current manifest: 10 exams (retake-practice-1 through retake-practice-10). RP11 would be retake-practice-11.
